current.text: Joined Portland in a trade from Memphis.
Projected to start in the backcourt next to Damian Lillard. Portland plans to stagger them but close games with both.
Portland's backcourt is crowded. Lillard, Jrue Holiday, Deni Avdija and Scoot Henderson all share the ball and the playmaking with him.
Portland has a new head coach.
His usage was 33% in Memphis and should fall by almost 5 points in Portland. His assists are unlikely to stay near 8 per game, and teammates who finish poorly make assists harder to convert.
Experts call him a weird fit in Portland who mutes the strengths of Lillard and Avdija.
Expect his minutes and usage to swing from game to game across Portland's rotation.
Auction value about 5 USD, maybe 10 USD if everything goes right. He went for 11 USD in a mock auction.
He should play enough minutes to beat a Yahoo rank of 103, but experts say not to take him in the top 50.
Tier 8 point guard on his median outcome. Averaging 24 points and 9 assists, or playing 65 games, is possible but unlikely upside.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs and a five-game week starting February 8.

durable.text: He cannot stay healthy. Experts flag his durability as a major concern.
He has off-court problems and has been suspended by his own team.
High-usage guard who piles up assists, even when he plays only a few games.
He is a poor shooter from the field and from three and does not move off the ball. His free throw shooting has improved a lot.
Turnovers are his worst category. They are far above the league and his position.
Not a good category player. His fantasy game is not robust, and he is worth more in points leagues.

note: Our league paid 17 USD for him last season. His market is much lower now: Yahoo average cost is 2.3 USD (value 5) and ESPN is 4.3 USD, and experts value him at 5 to 10 USD. He is a cheap guard who adds assists, points and FT% but costs you heavily in TO and some FG%, so he fits a punt TO build best. Early in the season, check how much usage and how many assists he keeps next to Lillard and Holiday, and whether he stays healthy.
